title: Iced Mocha
subtitle: Chocolate milk and coffee syrup over ice, crowned with vanilla ice cream and choco chips.
protein: ~7g protein per glass — from milk and ice cream

method.title: Chocolate milk
items: Chill the serving glasses in the freezer for 5 min
Whisk or blend {@milk} with {@choc-syrup:blend} until smooth and frothy

method.label: Toddler — pour hers now (before the coffee)
items: Pour {=¼ cup} of the chocolate milk into her cup — no coffee for her

method.title: Add coffee and serve
items: Whisk {@syrup} into the rest of the chocolate milk
Divide {@ice} between the chilled glasses and pour the mocha over
Top each glass with a scoop of {@ice-cream|vanilla ice cream} and a sprinkle of {@choco-chips}
Drizzle with {@choc-syrup:drizzle} and dust with {@coffee}; serve straight away

method.label: Tip
method.text: Ranveer Brar's card lists only ingredients; the method here is built around them, and the ice is added to make it an iced mocha. Chocolate syrup has a trace of caffeine, so keep her share small.
